coverage: Verified sha256 of inputs/project/rc_filter.kicad_sch, inputs/project/rc_filter.kicad_pcb and inputs/requirements.txt against the packet before analysis.

Independent schematic netlist export (kicad-cli 10.0.7, review-work/circuit/experiments/my_netlist.xml): confirmed /IN={J1.1,R1.1}, /OUT={C1.1,J1.2,R1.2}, GND={C1.2,J1.3}, matching the declared contract (pin1 input, pin2 filtered output, pin3 ground) and matching packet work/netlist/design.xml; J1's 180-degree symbol rotation resolved by the netlister, not by hand.

Board connectivity re-derived with the pcbnew Python API on the saved file (review-work/circuit/experiments/connectivity_check.py): pad-to-net assignments match the schematic; ratsnest unconnected count = 0 with the zone fill as saved, so each net (/IN, /OUT including the mid-segment T-junction at (107.5,100), GND) is a single copper cluster; corroborates work/drc/drc.json zero unconnected/parity issues.

Ground return path for J1 pad 3 verified geometrically (review-work/circuit/experiments/zone_check.py): single GND zone confirmed on B.Cu only, IsFilled, via at (113,100) inside the saved fill, and fill copper present at 45/135/225/315 degrees just outside the pad-3 edge (four thermal spokes) while absent on the axes; GetConnectedItems(J1.3) includes the ZONE.

Functional sanity of the extracted topology with ngspice-42 (review-work/circuit/experiments/rc_lowpass.cir): AC sweep measures f(-3 dB) = 158.78 Hz at J1.2 vs analytic 1/(2*pi*10k*100n) = 159.15 Hz, confirming pin 2 is the low-pass-filtered version of pin 1.

Reviewed packet check records work/erc/erc.json (0 violations), work/drc/drc.json (0 violations/unconnected/parity), work/netlist/connectivity.json and work/geometry/geometry.json for consistency with my independent extraction; no discrepancies found.
Methods, commands, versions and outcomes recorded in review-work/circuit/experiments/notes.md.
limitations: Zone/pad connectivity was evaluated on the fill polygon as saved in the read-only board file; no zone refill was performed, so connectivity after a future refill with changed settings was not assessed (J1 pad 3's only GND path is the B.Cu zone).

Per inputs/requirements.txt only the stated connectivity contract was evaluated; no component ratings, tolerances, source/load impedance, transient, EMC or qualification analysis was performed, and no part datasheets were applicable (generic passives/header).

ERC/DRC ignored-check lists in the fresh runs (e.g. single_global_label, footprint_filter, missing_courtyard) were accepted as harness configuration; I did not re-run with those checks enabled, though manual inspection showed labels IN/OUT each used at >=2 locations and footprints consistent with symbols.

The wx PROPERTY_ENUM assertion messages on stderr of the geometry probe (work/geometry/console.log) were reproduced locally with pcbnew 10.0.7 and treated as benign tool noise, not candidate behavior.
